Bases, tables and records in the Airtable workspaces a token can reach.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [airtable.com](https://airtable.com/create/tokens)
- **Setting:** `AIRTABLE_API_TOKEN`
- **API reference:** [airtable.com](https://airtable.com/developers/web/api/introduction)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Airtable and open [airtable.com](https://airtable.com/create/tokens).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** A personal access token from airtable.com/create/tokens, limited to the scopes and bases the app needs; the Gateway sends it as a bearer token. Listing records by POST (listRecords) needs write access; the GET form doesn't.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Airtable) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
pnpm everyapp secret set AIRTABLE_API_TOKEN
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `pnpm everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  airtable: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"` (or `"write"` where it changes things). The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `pnpm everyapp provider show airtable` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `pnpm everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.
- To test the key itself, `GET https://api.airtable.com/v0/meta/whoami` with it should answer 200; the call is free.

### Cost and limits

- **Rate limits:** 5 calls a second. 5 requests per second per base; 50 per second across all of one user's personal access tokens.
